# Acknowledgments {.unnumbered}

The research community provides the foundation on which a book like this rests. Work on generative models, language, retrieval, evaluation, and responsible AI has made it possible to study both the capabilities of these systems and the questions they leave unresolved. I acknowledge the researchers whose papers, methods, and findings inform the chapter discussions and reading lists. Their work gives readers a basis for investigation beyond these pages.

Open research and open-source software make technical learning more accessible and more open to examination. Public papers, shared implementations, documentation, and reproducible examples allow readers to look beneath an interface, trace a method, and test an explanation. I am grateful for the effort that goes into creating and maintaining these resources, including the less visible work of explaining limitations, documenting changes, and making results easier to reproduce.

Educators and students give open educational materials their purpose. The questions that arise while learning a difficult subject remind us that access involves more than making a file available. Clear explanations, opportunities to practice, and room to question a design all matter. This book's emphasis on a sustained project reflects the value of connecting ideas through decisions that can be discussed and defended.

Global Data Science Institute provides the publication home for this open edition. Making technical education accessible is an ongoing responsibility, and the ability to share and adapt educational material is part of that work. I hope the book supports careful study, useful discussion, and further contributions to open technical education. Responsibility for the presentation and interpretation in these pages remains with the author.
